info.title: MockForge Registry Server API
info.description:
This document describes the **CORE surface** of the MockForge Cloud API served by the Registry Server (`registry.mockforge.dev`). It covers health/meta endpoints, authentication, scoped API tokens, projects, organizations, the marketplace (templates, scenarios, plugins), hosted mock deployments, and core billing operations.

Other capability groups exist on the platform **beyond this document**, including workspaces, AI studio, SSO, admin, and extended observability APIs.

## Authentication
Two credential types are accepted via the same HTTP bearer scheme:

- A JWT access token obtained from login/registration (`Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`).
- A scoped API token created from the tokens endpoint (sent identically as a bearer token; permissions limited by its scopes).

Endpoints marked public require no credentials.

## Rate limits
Global limit of 60 requests per minute and a per-user limit of 100 requests per minute. Exceeding either returns `429`.

## Errors
Errors are returned as structured JSON objects with an `error` field and optional human-readable `message`.

get.description: Returns the aggregate health of the Registry Server, including database connectivity and dependent services.
Kubernetes-style liveness probe indicating whether the process is running.
Kubernetes-style readiness probe indicating whether the server can serve traffic.

200.description: Service is ready to accept traffic.

get.description: Returns the current state of the circuit breakers guarding downstream dependencies.
Returns aggregate public statistics about the registry, such as counts of published templates, scenarios, and plugins.
Returns detailed runtime status of the Registry Server and its subsystems.
Returns the frequently asked questions served by the registry.
Returns the current MockForge Cloud Terms of Service document.
Returns the current MockForge Cloud Privacy Policy document.
Returns the current Data Processing Agreement document.
Returns publicly visible billing configuration such as available plans and pricing tiers.

post.description: Creates a new MockForge Cloud account with a username, email, and password, and returns an initial access token.
Authenticates with email and password (and a two-factor code when 2FA is enabled) and returns an access/refresh token pair.

two_factor_code.description: TOTP code, required when two-factor authentication is enabled.

post.description: Exchanges a refresh token for a new token pair. When no refresh token is supplied in the body, the `mockforge_refresh` cookie is used instead.

refresh_token.description: Omit to fall back to the mockforge_refresh cookie.

post.description: Invalidates the current session/refresh token and clears authentication cookies.
Sends a password-reset email to the given address if it corresponds to an existing account.
Completes a password reset using the token delivered by email and a new password.

get.description: Confirms an email address using the verification token supplied as a query parameter.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Email verification token from the verification link.

get.description: Validates the presented JWT or API token and returns basic identity claims when it is valid.
Returns profile information for the user identified by the presented bearer credentials.

post.description: Changes the password of the authenticated user after verifying the current password.
Creates a new API token with the given name and scopes. The full token value is returned exactly once and cannot be retrieved afterwards.

get.description: Lists the authenticated user's API tokens. Only metadata is returned; token secrets are never exposed.
Returns every scope that may be granted to an API token, with labels and descriptions.

delete.description: Permanently revokes the identified API token. Requests bearing the revoked token are rejected thereafter.

parameters.name: token_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the token to revoke.

post.description: Issues a replacement secret for the identified token. The new secret is shown once.

parameters.name: token_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the token to rotate.

200.description: Token rotated; new secret shown once.

get.description: Lists projects visible to the authenticated user.
Lists organizations the authenticated user belongs to.

post.description: Creates a new organization owned by the authenticated user.

get.description: Fetches an organization by its URL-friendly slug.
Fetches a single organization by identifier.

patch.description: Applies a partial update to an organization the caller is permitted to administer.

delete.description: Deletes an organization and its associated resources.

get.description: Lists the members of an organization together with their roles.

post.summary: Add a member to an organization
post.description: Invites or adds a user to the organization with a specific role.

patch.description: Changes a member's role or other membership attributes.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the member to update.

delete.description: Removes a user from the organization.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the member to remove.

get.description: Returns the resource quotas configured for the organization.

put.description: Updates the resource quotas configured for the organization.

get.description: Returns current resource consumption of the organization against its quotas.
Returns billing information for the organization, such as plan state and payment summary.

post.description: Searches published templates by free-text query, category, and tags, with pagination.
Publishes a new template (or new version of an existing template) to the marketplace.

get.description: Retrieves the metadata and details of a specific version of a named template.
Lists community reviews for a specific version of a template.

post.description: Searches published scenarios by free-text query, category, and tags.
Publishes a scenario package to the marketplace. The package is supplied base64-encoded together with its manifest and checksum.

get.description: Retrieves metadata for a named scenario, including its latest version.
Retrieves details for a specific version of a named scenario.

post.description: Searches published plugins. The request body carries search filters.
Publishes a new plugin (or new version of an existing plugin) to the marketplace.

get.description: Retrieves metadata for a named plugin, including its available versions.
Retrieves details for a specific version of a named plugin.
Downloads the distributable artifact for a specific version of a named plugin.
Lists community reviews for a named plugin.

post.description: Submits a review for a named plugin as the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns the security analysis report for a named plugin.

post.description: Uploads an OpenAPI specification for hosting and returns the URL at which it can be referenced by subsequent deployments.
Creates a new hosted mock deployment from a previously uploaded spec or inline configuration.

get.description: Lists hosted mock deployments visible to the authenticated user.
Fetches a single hosted mock deployment by identifier.

delete.description: Tears down and deletes the identified hosted mock deployment.

patch.description: Reports a status transition for a deployment, optionally with an error message and resulting deployment URL.

post.description: Triggers a redeployment of an existing hosted mock, optionally with updated configuration or a new spec URL.

spec_url.description: URL of a replacement OpenAPI spec.

post.summary: Run smoke tests against a deployment
post.description: Starts a smoke-test run against the deployment, optionally constrained by a latency budget and HTTP methods.

methods.description: HTTP methods to exercise during the run.

post.description: Associates a custom domain with the deployment.

domain.description: Custom hostname to associate with the deployment.

post.description: Stops serving the deployment while retaining its configuration.
Resumes serving a previously stopped deployment.

get.description: Returns build/deployment logs for the deployment.
Returns runtime logs emitted while the deployed mock has been serving traffic.
Returns recorded runtime requests served by the deployment.
Returns request-counting metrics for the deployment, broken down by response class.
Returns captured request/response pairs recorded for the deployment while capture is enabled.

post.description: Turns on recording of request/response pairs for the deployment.
Turns off recording of request/response pairs for the deployment.
Discards all previously captured traffic for the deployment.
Replays captured request/response pairs against the deployment, e.g. to seed fixtures.

get.description: Exports all captured traffic for the deployment in HTTP Archive (HAR) format.
Exports all captured traffic for the deployment as newline-delimited JSON records.

200.description: JSON Lines stream of captured records.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's active subscription, including plan and renewal state.
Lists invoices issued for the authenticated user's subscription.

post.description: Creates a Stripe Checkout session for starting or upgrading a subscription.
Creates a Stripe Customer Portal session so the user can manage billing, invoices, and payment methods.

bearerAuth.description: JWT access token obtained from login/registration, or a scoped API token; both are sent as `Authorization: Bearer <credential>`.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or insufficiently scoped credentials.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not permitted to perform this action.

PaymentRequired.description: Payment required before the operation can complete.

AuthResponseV2.description: Authentication response with refresh token support.

access_token_expires_at.description: Expiry timestamp of the access token.

TokenCreate.description: Request to create a scoped API token.

TokenCreated.description: Creation result for an API token; the secret value is shown exactly once.

token.description: Full token secret; only ever returned here.

token_id.description: Identifier used to manage (rotate/revoke) the token later.

token_prefix.description: Non-secret prefix used to identify the token in listings.

TokenInfo.description: API token metadata as returned by listings; never includes the secret.

Scope.description: A scope that can be granted to an API token.

value.description: Scope identifier to pass in TokenCreate.scopes.

Organization.description: An organization account. Detailed field layout is not part of this core specification.

Member.description: An organization membership. Detailed field layout is not part of this core specification.

TemplateSearchEntry.description: A template entry within search results.

project_id.description: Owning project, when the deployment belongs to one.

DeploymentStatusUpdate.description: Status transition report for a deployment.

error_message.description: Error detail when the transition reports a failure.

deployment_url.description: URL where the deployment is reachable after the transition.

Metrics.description: Request metrics for a hosted mock deployment.
